changes.content:
# House JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). Unconstrained patterns keep identifiers,
# dates and serialized scalar data exact-match without changing accepted values.
crm_company:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    name:
      type: string
    sector:
      type: string
    linkedin_url:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    website:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    phone_number:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    address:
      type: string
    zipcode:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    city:
      type: string
    state_abbr:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    sales_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    created_at:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    description:
      type: string
    revenue:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    tax_identifier:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    country:
      type: string
    size:
      type: number
    context_links:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    logo:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - name
  - created_at
crm_contact:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    first_name:
      type: string
    last_name:
      type: string
    title:
      type: string
    company_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    linkedin_url:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    first_seen:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    last_seen:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    gender:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    sales_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    status:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    background:
      type: string
    has_newsletter:
      enum:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    email_jsonb:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    phone_jsonb:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    tags:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    avatar:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - first_name
  - last_name
  - first_seen
  - last_seen
crm_deal:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    name:
      type: string
    company_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    category:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    stage:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    description:
      type: string
    created_at:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    updated_at:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    archived_at:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    expected_closing_date:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    sales_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    amount:
      type: number
    index:
      type: number
    contact_ids:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - name
  - company_id
  - stage
  - created_at
  - updated_at
  - amount
  - index
crm_task:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    contact_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    task_type:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    text:
      type: string
    due_date:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    done_date:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    sales_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - contact_id
  - text
  - due_date
crm_contact_note:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    contact_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    text:
      type: string
    date:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    sales_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    status:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    attachments:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - contact_id
  - date
crm_deal_note:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    deal_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    text:
      type: string
    date:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    sales_id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    attachments:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - deal_id
  - date
crm_sale:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    first_name:
      type: string
    last_name:
      type: string
    email:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    administrator:
      enum:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    disabled:
      enum:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    secondary_emails:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    avatar:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - first_name
  - last_name
crm_tag:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    name:
      type: string
    color:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - name
  - color
crm_configuration:
  properties:
    id:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
    config:
      type: string
      pattern: ^[\s\S]*$
  required:
  - id
  - config
